decisions.reason: The mobile high-speed flail shredders build directly on the firm's mobile processing know-how, installed-base service capability, and ability to learn from adjacent applications, so management would likely continue refining rather than withdraw them.

The mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's core recycling machinery knowledge and can absorb lessons from related grinder and shredder projects, although somewhat higher product-line overlap and market uncertainty keep the withdrawal risk modestly elevated.

The stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's established stationary equipment competence and resource-efficient development path, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve the product commercially instead of exiting it.
